reason: I know my regulars by name, I don't need a screen to tell me who is first-time or a loyalty reward like a chain. I might take the free listing, but I won't hand my guests' payments and contacts to a startup I've never heard of, even for three free months.
objection: A new startup - will it still exist in a year, and who owns my guest data? Plus a fee on every payment on top of my terminal, on my margins.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it running for a season in cafés I know, with a written promise that the guest list is mine to export and keep if they close - then maybe for the summer tourists who want to pay fast.
